tasks.title: Create the remote_filter_settings table and promote its staged migration
tasks.dod: drizzle-kit generates the next migration from `remote-filter/infra/schema.ts`, and `remote-filter-schema.integration.test.ts` shows on a temp DB the five columns of the staged SQL and the NOT NULL failure on `filter_on`.

tasks.title: Build the country vocabulary from Intl plus the hand-kept alias, region, zone, filler and short-code tables
tasks.dod: `vocabulary.test.ts` passes: PL/US/GB/NZ pinned (names, zones, winter and summer offsets), the lookup accepts name/alias/flag case-insensitively and refuses "Polnd", "Europe" and "CA".

tasks.title: Read one location statement and decide one listing's verdict for a country and a date
tasks.dod: `statement.test.ts` passes for every AC-01 and AC-02 statement and the edge cases above, each giving the same verdict on 15 January and 15 July.

tasks.title: Combine listing verdicts into one posting verdict and pin the fixed example set at a winter and a summer date
tasks.dod: `verdict.test.ts` passes: 100% of the fixed examples give their expected verdict on both dates, and the property test finds no `not_open` for unknown, unrecognised, exception or hours-only statements.

tasks.title: Keep an explicit "Anywhere" as stated in the collector, treat it as nothing stated for merge and change checks, and export it with the enabled sources
tasks.dod: `listing.test.ts` and `merge.test.ts` cover the predicate and the merge rule, and `collector-ingest` / `collector-adapters` integration tests show "Anywhere" kept as stated, never blocking a merge, and `null` → "Anywhere" not counted as an updated posting.

tasks.title: Write the settings repo with the lazily created singleton row and its test fixture
tasks.dod: `remote-filter-repo.integration.test.ts` passes on a temp DB: lazy create, each write, look cleared as a pair, and values surviving a close-and-reopen of the DB file.

tasks.title: Implement the settings use cases: choose country, switch on/off, start or end a look, the country list, and the active filter for a visit
tasks.dod: `remote-filter-settings.integration.test.ts` passes every row of the edge-case table plus AC-04's reopen (a fresh deps on the same DB file reads Poland, on) and AC-13's change to Portugal.

tasks.title: Answer search's verdict question: verdicts for a set of postings and a country, from open listings of enabled sources, one parse per distinct statement
tasks.dod: `remote-filter-verdicts.integration.test.ts` passes for the three AC-03 postings and the closed / disabled-source listings.

tasks.title: Expose remote-filter's four routes behind the access guard and register the plugin in app.ts
tasks.dod: `remote-filter-routes.integration.test.ts` validates every response against `contracts/openapi.yaml` and proves both AC-12 refusals leave the row unchanged.

tasks.title: Make search's main list location-aware: active filter, verdicts before the snapshot, hidden/total/new counts, check reasons and the waiting count
tasks.dod: `search-location.integration.test.ts` passes: AC-01/02 list and reasons, 102/38/140 counts and off (AC-07), all-hidden (AC-08), 2 waiting + new after refresh + new-when-switched-off (AC-09), Germany look and its end (AC-06), hidden look-alike with no hint and marked view unchanged (AC-11) — every response valid against the contract; existing search suites green.

tasks.title: Add the web remote-filter client, the LocationFilterBar and the CountryChoice on SCR-01
tasks.dod: the LocationFilterBar and CountryChoice tests pass for every bar mode (none, own, off, look, loading, switching, error) and every choice state (open, saving, unknown name, saved, save error, cancelled), and `remoteFilter.test.ts` passes.

tasks.title: Wire the filter into the main list: re-search on change, hidden count in the summary, the check-location mark, the filter's empty message and the marked view
tasks.dod: `PostingCard.test.tsx` and `SearchList.test.tsx` pass for the four check reasons, the summary with and without its hidden part, the filter's empty message winning over nothing-left-to-review, the off and look states, and the bar hidden in the marked view.

tasks.title: Prove "Anywhere" end to end from collection to verdict, and search speed with the filter on
tasks.dod: `remote-filter-e2e.integration.test.ts` passes AC-10 and AC-11 through the real collector and routes, and `search-nfr.integration.test.ts` passes with the filter on for Poland at p95 ≤ 1 s.

tasks.title: Add the hidden count and one-off look to CONTEXT.md, amend the collector spec's "Anywhere" reading, and point applied-skipped's contract at this one
tasks.dod: `grep -n "Hidden count\|One-off look" CONTEXT.md` shows both entries, the collector spec carries the three amendment lines, and the applied-skipped contract still passes `redocly lint` with the three supersede notes.
